summary: Frontend-only testing of Chullz Poker React+Vite PWA at https://card-battle-arena-76.preview.emergentagent.com. All core features verified at mobile viewport 390x844. Login screen, PIN modal, lobby, create table modal, poker table oval layout, and back navigation all working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Back button (←) is 36x36px, below the 44px minimum touch target recommendation. Code: width:36, height:36 in button style.
Join button on table cards is 63x40px (height 40px), slightly below 44px minimum touch target.

action_items: MINOR: Increase back button (←) in PokerTable from 36x36 to 44x44px for proper touch target
MINOR: Increase Join button padding in Lobby tables to achieve 44px height
INFO: React Router v6 future flag warnings in console (non-breaking, upgrade to v7 when ready)
INFO: Transient WebSocket error on reconnect (ws close before establish) - reconnect logic handles this fine
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: App title is 'Chullz Poker' (from index.html <title>)
VERIFIED: Dark background #060b14 (rgb(6,11,20)) confirmed on login screen
VERIFIED: All 7 profiles shown in 2-column grid: AceKing🦁, BluffMaster🐺, CardShark🦊, PokerPro🐻, AllInAndy🦅, HighRoller🐯, TableAdmin👑(ADMIN badge)
VERIFIED: Profile cards are 173x168px - well above 44px touch target minimum
VERIFIED: PIN modal opens on profile click with numpad (all 12 buttons: 72x56px each, above 44px)
VERIFIED: Wrong PIN shows 'Wrong PIN. Try again.' in red, PIN dots clear correctly
VERIFIED: Correct PIN 1111 auto-submits after 4 digits and navigates to /lobby
VERIFIED: Lobby shows 'Online Players' row with all player avatars, 'Tables' section, '+ Create Table' button (53px height) at bottom
VERIFIED: Create Table modal is bottom sheet with TABLE NAME input, Blinds 25/50, Starting 🪙5,000, Max Players 6, 'Create & Join Table' button
VERIFIED: Table creation POST /api/tables/create + /api/tables/join works and navigates to /table/[id]?host=true
VERIFIED: Poker table shows vertical portrait oval (green felt: 255x412px, ratio 1.61 - taller than wide), brown wood border/rail
VERIFIED: In WAITING state oval shows '♠ CHULLZ', '3 BOARD POT LIMIT', player count - 3 boards only show when game active (correct behavior)
VERIFIED: 5 empty seat slots visible around oval with 'Empty' labels and dashed circles
VERIFIED: AceKing player seat at bottom with avatar, chips (5.0k), WAITING status, 'You' badge
VERIFIED: Back button (←) navigates from poker table back to /lobby successfully
VERIFIED: No horizontal overflow at 390x844 viewport on both login and lobby screens
VERIFIED: Admin profile (TableAdmin) routes to /admin path (from code: role === 'admin' ? '/admin' : '/lobby')

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all core features verified, 2 minor touch target issues

seed_data_creation: Used pre-existing AceKing/1111 account. Test tables created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified at 390x844 mobile viewport. Login: click profile -> click numpad digits (auto-submit at 4 digits), AceKing=1111, BluffMaster=2222.
